description: Holds vehicle maintenance pricing records (defined in the EF Core model), linked to fuel type, job grade, vehicle type.
business_purpose: Used to track and report vehicle maintenance pricing records, including amounts and quantities, for the Factory & Inventory area.
record_granularity: One row represents one vehicle maintenance pricing.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Unique identifier of the vehicle maintenance pricing.

columns.name: created_byId
columns.description: User who created the vehicle maintenance pricing.

columns.name: created_date
columns.description: Date and time when the record was created.

columns.name: fuel_typeId
columns.description: Reference to the fuel type linked to this vehicle maintenance pricing.

columns.name: gradeId
columns.description: Reference to the job grade linked to this vehicle maintenance pricing.

columns.name: is_deleted
columns.description: Soft-delete flag. True when the record has been deleted.

columns.name: modified_byId
columns.description: User who last modified the vehicle maintenance pricing.

columns.name: modified_date
columns.description: Date and time when the record was last modified.

columns.name: price
columns.description: Price of the vehicle maintenance pricing.

columns.name: vehicle_typeId
columns.description: Reference to the vehicle type linked to this vehicle maintenance pricing.

relationships.description: User who created the vehicle maintenance pricing.
Each vehicle maintenance pricing references one fuel type (fuel type).
Each vehicle maintenance pricing references one job grade (grade).
User who last modified the vehicle maintenance pricing.
Each vehicle maintenance pricing references one vehicle type (vehicle type).

business_rules: Deleted records (is_deleted = 1) should normally be excluded from reporting.
created_date is the preferred date column for period-based reporting.
Use price for monetary or quantity totals.
Join to Fuel Type, Job Grade, Vehicle Type through the foreign key columns to resolve names.
VehicleMaintenancePricing is defined in the EF Core model but was not found in the connected database, so it may not be deployed there.
common_queries: Vehicle Maintenance Pricing by fuel type
Vehicle Maintenance Pricing by job grade
Vehicle Maintenance Pricing by vehicle type

query_notes: Do not generate SQL against VehicleMaintenancePricing: no table or view with this name exists in the connected database.
Always filter is_deleted = 0 unless deleted records are explicitly requested.
Use COUNT(DISTINCT id) when counting vehicle maintenance pricing records; joins can duplicate rows.
Use SUM(price) for totals of price.
To resolve names, join on: fuel_typeId = FuelType.Id; gradeId = JobGrade.Id; vehicle_typeId = VehicleType.Id.
Defined in the EF Core model but not found in the connected database; confirm it has been migrated before relying on it.
